source_name: San Diego Unified Port District Act
notes: The act establishes the San Diego Unified Port District and states the district area includes the corporate area of San Diego, Chula Vista, Coronado, National City, and Imperial Beach, with district regulatory, taxing, and police power jurisdiction over granted tidelands and related lands.
